title: Decentralized Identity (DiD)
description: Client-side, private, non-custodial, and entirely censorship-resistant. Your sovereign identity layer—generated on your device, never held by us.

title: Multi-Chain Unified Wallet Factory
description: One cryptographic identity mapping to addresses across 5 chains, allowing seamless rotation if compromised.

title: Self-Custody Reputation Layer
description: Work history stored as signed credentials. Historical scores sit on permanent, user-owned logs (SizChain X) so they persist even if the platform goes offline.

title: Institutional-Grade ERP Systems
description: Smart contract tokenized workflows and stablecoin escrows for automated, intermediate-free milestone payouts.

title: Modular CRM Tools
description: White-label, vertical-specific workflow engines for non-custodial client and delivery management.

title: Digital Economies for Remote Teams
description: Infrastructure for remote teams to establish localized token micro-economies and internal reputation tracking.

title: RWA Tokenization
description: Laying the groundwork for reputation-backed lending and micro-grants using on-chain credit scores.
